ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels on visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discrete high-intensity white circular spots (diameter ~10-20 pixels) scattered mid-lobe on both sides; dense high-intensity white clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips; low-intensity black background with subtle mid-intensity grey mottling near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 18% of the visible lobe vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along both trailing edges; left lobe shows consistent small-amplitude variations; right lobe features high-amplitude, irregular peaks and deep indentations (>40 pixels) towards the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curve from the notch towards the tips; the right lobe sweep is significantly disrupted and non-continuous due to deep marginal tissue voids.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated on the left and right distal margins; at least four distinct white circular ring marks (scars) visible on the central-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and trauma at the tip of the right lobe (viewer's right), resulting in a jagged, multi-pronged profile with heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique deep, step-like notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from standard serration patterns.
